test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following committees had recommended to incorporate the Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is the__** Swaran Singh Committee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Fundamental Duties were incorporated in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution through the 42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.**
 
• At present, there are eleven fundamental duties under Article 51 A of the Constitution.
 
• The idea of Fundamental Duties has been borrowed from the erstwhile USSR.
 
• Originally the duties were ten in number, later on through the 86th Amendment Act, of 2002, the eleventh Fundamental duty was added.
 
• Fundamental duties are non-enforceable in nature.
 
• **Swaran Singh Committee recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **The Sarkaria Commission was set up on 9th June 1983 by the Government of India.**

 
 
• Aim: To review the relations between the Centre and the States.
 
• Justice Rajendra Singh Sarkaria, a retired Judge of SC of India, was the Chairman of the commission.
 
• The other two members of the commission were:
 
 
• Shri B. Sivaraman
 
• Dr S R Sen​
 
 
 
 
 
• **PB Patil Committee was constituted for the evaluation of the Panchayat Raj system in 1984.**
 
 
• The committee emphasized involving people and gave 184 recommendations for reforming the system and enabling greater participation.
 
 
 
• Balwant Rai Mehta Committee was appointed to examine the working of the community development program and the national extension service.
 
 
• Balwant Rai Mehta Committee was appointed in 1957.
 
• Balwant Rai Mehta was the chairman of this committee.
 
• **The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee recommended establishing a three-tier Panchayati Raj structure.**
